item.title: The State Legislative Assembly Isn’t A House To Recite Statistics, But To Solve Problems — Perak Doctor
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
A state legislative assembly is where elected reps are meant to translate numbers into policy. Health care manpower is heavily shaped by federal policy, but this doesn't absolve state govts of responsibility. Perak should learn from Johor, Sabah, Sarawak.
